name: McGill University
description: McGill University is a public research university in Montreal, Quebec, founded in 1821. It teaches in English and is known for medicine, law, science and engineering, with international students making up nearly 30% of its enrolment.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website); its MD, CM is on the Singapore Medical Council's list, and the campus has a Malaysian and Singaporean Students' Association.

programmes.name: Doctor of Medicine and Master of Surgery (MDCM)
programmes.summary: Year 1 tuition is about C$74,700 (63 credits). At the same fixed per-credit rate, year 2 is about C$59,900, year 3 about C$60,500 and year 4 about C$42,100. Compulsory fees of about C$2,850 a year included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: Student Accounts '2026-2027 Tuition Rates - International Undergraduate Students' (updated December 2025): MDCM tuition C$74,678.31 for students admitted Fall 2026, based on 63 credits in Year 1 (the heaviest year; McGill lists 50.5, 51 and 35.5 credits for Years 2-4, so later years cost less). Per-credit rate guaranteed for the programme. Compulsory = society C$779.50 + student services/athletics C$774.60 + admin C$651.89 + copyright C$55.05 + IT C$440.55 + SSMU dental C$150 (estimated by McGill at +3%); international health insurance (C$1,155) excluded. Graduate-entry MDCM is 4 years. 2025 history from the '2025-2026 Tuition Rates - International Undergraduate Students' PDF (updated November 2024): MDCM tuition C$69,339.06 for students admitted Fall 2025 (63 credits), compulsory C$2,823.52 on the same basis. No 2024 row: the 2024-25 rates PDF is no longer online and the MDCM web tables show each cohort at its current year of study (not Year 1), so no source states the Fall 2024 cohort's Year-1 figure. 2024 row from Student Accounts 'International / Doctor of Medicine and Master of Surgery (MDCM) / Fall 2024/Winter 2025' web table (https://www.mcgill.ca/student-accounts/doctor-medicine-and-master-surgery-mdcm-5, now 404; Wayback capture 20250916143940; 'Tuition rates shown below are established for 2024-25'). Column 'Admitted and enrolled as of Fall 2024 (Yr 1)', 63.00 average credits: tuition C$64,381.59; compulsory = society 748.04 + student services/athletics 737.30 + registration/admin 620.56 + IT 432.00 + copyright 68.67 + SSMU dental 150.00 = C$2,756.57; international health insurance C$1,047 excluded (column total C$68,185.16 checks). In the 2024-25 version of this table the Fall 2024 cohort is shown in Year 1, so it states that cohort's Year-1 figure on the same 63-credit basis as the 2025 and 2026 rows. laterYears added 2026-10-08 from the figures above; annualTuition is now the year-1 figure.
